verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never describes a project or space feature that groups chats and files under shared context or instructions. The Library (perplexity-docs-13) is only described as curated search history. Labs (perplexity-docs-10) is about producing reports and projects as outputs, not organizing them. API 'profiles' (perplexity-docs-37) are reusable model configurations, not workspaces for a knowledge-worker. Organizing work this way is a fair axis for an AI answer assistant, so the lack of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
